analysis_plan.no_capability_claim: Readiness licenses a search run; it is not evidence about one.
analysis_plan.null_handling: Findings are recorded as measured; no threshold is relaxed after seeing results, and a marginal task is never rounded up to admitted.
analysis_plan.primary: Per task: the admission verdict in each of K rounds, the resulting classification, and the per-round criterion values so an instability can be attributed to a specific criterion.

claim_boundary: Replicated readiness audit of the executable task substrate. Measures properties of reward functions only. Makes no claim about scaffold improvement, model self-improvement, or a recursive effect.

classification.marginal: admitted in some rounds but not all

corrections_revalidated_here: MIN_TIMING_REPEATS floor in the paired harness
gcd_fixed timing argument reduced from 120_000 to 20_000
correctness gating added to the optimize_function paired scorer, which in E67 measured timing without checking the candidate was correct

instrument.primary_metric: reward; 0.0 is the starting solution, 1.0 the reference

predictions.basis: The central methodological claim. power_mod already disagreed between E66 and E67. If nothing is marginal, single-run admission was adequate after all and this experiment is unnecessary.
predictions.statement: At least one task is marginal — admitted in some rounds and not others.

predictions.basis: Admitted in E66 at +0.0261, rejected in E67 at +0.0533.
28x headroom against hundreds for the others; rejected in E64, E65, E66 and E67.
predictions.statement: count_primes_v2 is rejected in every round.

predictions.basis: 8740x headroom, and the widest margin on every criterion in E67.
Pessimistic. Scouting saw anchor self-scores beyond 0.05 for both gcd_fixed and power_mod under load. If this is wrong the substrate is in better shape than expected.
predictions.statement: Fewer than three tasks are solid, so the substrate is still not ready.

question: When admission is replicated rather than taken from one run, which tasks hold up?
readiness_rule: The substrate is ready for a governed search run only if at least three tasks are SOLID. Marginal tasks do not count: a verdict that changes between runs is not yet a measurement.
